description: goo 2026-07-29 (ดวงสมพงศ์ REFRAME 3, ฟีม): the add-friend contract now takes the user's CHOSEN gender instead of the Slice-1 gap-default. gender is a real bazi calc input — locking it to MALE = permanently wrong compute, so this is a correctness fix. Bug-class the anchor owns: a gender that reaches the API as MALE WITHOUT the user choosing it (the exact bug REFRAME 3 fixes — the problem was 'ผู้ใช้เลือกไม่ได้', not 'the default is wrong'). Change: NewFriendForm += gender:'MALE'|'FEMALE' as a closed REQUIRED union (''/undefined not representable → a form omitting it is a tsc error); buildCreateFriendArgs uses form.gender at position 5 DIRECTLY — NO `|| COMPAT_FRIEND_DEFAULTS.gender` (บอง's catch: the || fallback silently makes an unchosen gender MALE = reopening the bug). COMPAT_FRIEND_DEFAULTS.gender='MALE' RETAINED for the record (ไม่ลบ) but NO LONGER a runtime fallback. Approach (option 2, chosen with μุน): μุน's V3 form pre-selects MALE VISIBLY (v1-style highlight, user sees+changes) so a value is always sent — the default is seen, not hidden. Teeth (scripts/compatibility.test.ts, RUN + mutant-proven): chosen gender flows both directions (MALE→MALE, FEMALE→FEMALE, FORM fixture=FEMALE so a hardcode-MALE mut is catchable); an absent/empty gender does NOT silently become MALE. mut-E hardcode COMPAT_FRIEND_DEFAULTS.gender → all 3 gender asserts fail → CAUGHT; mut-F reintroduce form.gender||DEFAULT → empty-gender assert fails ('' → MALE) → CAUGHT (this is บอง's requested 'form doesn't send gender → something red' tooth). done-cond #13(new) prove-the-value-sent; #14 gender picker = deliberate ฟีม-ordered Figma divergence (sheet 636:18533 dropped it, like ซินแส #146). done-cond #6: git diff ZERO pages/matching/** + constants/api/api-user-matching-*. SEAM: μุน owns the 2 buttons + visible pre-select + passes gender; goo's contract accepts+carries it. gate_layer=logic/required-union-no-silent-fallback+bazi-input-correctness.
